title: Build your first interface with a clean, modern front-end stack.
subtitle: This project is wired for React, Vite, Tailwind, ESLint, Prettier, and Docker. Start with layout experiments and iterate quickly with HMR.

steps.title: Explore layout
steps.body: Build a bold hero, then add 2-3 content sections with clear visual rhythm.

steps.title: Shape the UI system
steps.body: Define type scale, spacing steps, and a small color palette in Tailwind.

steps.title: Prototype interactions
steps.body: Add motion to cards, buttons, and section reveals for polish.
